title: LIS Relevance Classification
description: S05 Project 3 — Classify utterances as on_topic or off_topic per relevance rubric
label_config:
<View>
  <Header value="Relevance Classification" />
  <Header value="Read the utterance in context (see surrounding utterances). Classify as on_topic or off_topic." />
  <Text name="context_before" value="$context_before" />
  <Text name="utterance" value="$utterance" />
  <Text name="context_after" value="$context_after" />
  <Header value="Label" />
  <Choices name="relevance" toName="utterance" choice="single" showInline="true">
    <Choice value="on_topic" />
    <Choice value="off_topic" />
  </Choices>
  <Header value="Confidence" />
  <Rating name="confidence" toName="utterance" />
  <Choices name="flag" toName="utterance" choice="single" showInline="true">
    <Choice value="normal" />
    <Choice value="ambiguous" />
  </Choices>
  <TextArea name="notes" toName="utterance" rows="1" placeholder="Reason for decision (optional)..." />
</View>
